minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 27, 2020

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, February 27,
2020, at 2:04 pm in the City Council Chambers 9th Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Dept.
  Officer Loren Robinson, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Debra Crenshaw, City Treasures’ Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items
A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
February 13, 2020.

Special Permit Request(s):
Item # 1:  Ramona Wilder DBA Wilder Preparatory Charter School, to host 20th year
  Founder’s day Celebration at 830 N. La Brea Ave, on Monday, March 02,
  2020, from 8:00 a.m. – 11:00 a.m. Applicant to provide two (2) Traffic
  Control Officers for traffic control; adequate licensed security guards to
  monitor crowd control and to ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on and off site; Security guards shall wear distinctive uniforms
  to be easily identified by the public and Police; Security guard(s) navigating
  traffic must wear a reflective vest. Station trash receptacles throughout the
  event site for waste management. Applicant to maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is cleaned immediately at the end of the event and adhere to
  all State, Federal and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulation (Activity No. 00296801)

Item # 2:  Tony Sarkissan DBA Dancool HVAC Supply, Inc. to host a Grand Opening
  at 220 W Ivy, on Saturday, March 07, 2020, from 7:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
  Approval for one day event in industrial parking lot. Applicant to notify all
  tenants in building of event. Applicant responsible for crowd control and
  event clean up. Applicant to hire adequate professional / licensed security
  guards adequate licensed security guards to monitor crowd control and to
  ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on and off site; and adhere
  to all state, federal and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
 Permits & License Committee  February 27, 2020
Minutes  Page 2 of 6

  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00296654)

Item #3:  Daniel Kash DBA LAX AMMO Parking Lot Sale, to host a Sale of Sporting
  Goods in Inglewood at – 234 Hindry Ave , on Saturday, March 07, 2020 &
  Sunday March 8, 2020, from 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; subject to event being
  contained exclusively to the location listed on this application; cannot
  obstruct or use public sidewalks, streets or alleys; sales of firearm
  ammunition to any persons without proper/legal government-issued
  identification is strictly prohibited; loitering inside/outside the business
  location is strictly prohibited; Possession or sales of any
  illegal/unauthorized firearms, ammunition, equipment or items deemed to
  be a hazard to public safety are strictly prohibited; all events are subject to
  random inspection by an police, fire or code enforcement officer or official
  at any time during hours of operation; business owner is required to
  possess all applicable local, county, state and/or federal licensing for sales
  of items; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; LAX Ammunition staff is to maintain
  and manage crowd control throughout the duration of the event; Security
  guards carrying firearms must be authorized and licensed with the Bureau
  of Security and Investigative Services; armed and/or unarmed security
  guards shall wear distinctive uniforms to be easily identified by the public;
  any person directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective
  vests; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere
  to all state, federal and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00296708)

Item #4:  Lauren Elchoness DBA New Games Productions Inc., to Nickelodeon
  Slime Fest at 3900 W Manchester Blvd (Forum Parking Lot), on Saturday,
  March 21-22, 2020, from 10:00 a.m. – 6:30 p.m.; applicant to hire additional
  Forum Security and additional IPD staffing TBD. Applicant to submit
  identity list (name, DOB, CA License #, etc) of all carnival style gaming
  employees for proper police check prohibiting any sex registrants from
  working this event where children will be present. If alcoholic beverages
  are being served / sold in certain areas of this event, the applicant must be
  in compliance of all ABC regulations; hire two (2) Code Enforcement
  Officers for noise mitigation efforts for both days. Applicant to contact the
  Code Enforcement Office at 310.412.5590 to coordinate sound check prior
  to the start of the event and adhere to all state, federal and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00296582)

Item #5:  Angela Williams DBA City of Inglewood to host 2020 Earth Day Music
  Festival in Inglewood at –City Hall’s South Lawn, on Saturday, April 18,
  2020, from 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.; Applicant will contact Los Angeles
  County Fire Department (LACO FD) Chief Battalion to coordinate LACO
  FD staffing, Inglewood Police Department staffing (1 Sergeant, 6 Officers,
  4 Traffic Control Officer); Traffic Control Officers will be on location to
  ensure public safety, assist with road closures and effective flow of traffic
  on Queen St., Grevillea Ave. and surrounding areas, specifically where
 Permits & License Committee  February 27, 2020
Minutes  Page 3 of 6

  food trucks are operating. The Applicant will maintain safe and secure
  crowd control, maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event. Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site; and adhere to all State, Federal and local Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried and second. (Activity No. 00296545)

New Business Application Request(s):

Item #6:  Daniel Hernandez of Capitol Cuts. DBA Capitol Cuts to operate a Barber
  Shop at 4687 W. Century Blvd. Payment of annual business license and
  tax fees; Business owner must possess and maintain valid and current
  Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology;
  Cosmetologist’s, Barbers, Esthetician’s and Manicurists operating within
  the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist’s, Barbers, Esthetician’s and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment is required to register and
  file business tax with the City; Business owner shall provide valid and
  current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic
  beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted
  on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted;
  Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or
  any Peace Officer at anytime to ensure compliance and adhere to all State,
  Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00295836)

Item #7:  Ruben Rodriguez of Hertz Rental Car. DBA Hertz Rental Car to operate
  Rental Car Service at 140 E. Tamarack Ave. subject to approval for auto
  rental in C-S zone. Applicant to comply with all provision of 12-26 including:
  A rental or leasing office open to the public shall be maintained on the
  premises: the storage of automobiles without such office is prohibited. The
  rental, leasing or storage of trucks, trailers, inoperable vehicles and/or
  buses is prohibited. Only minor, incidental servicing of automobiles and
  non-ambulatory vehicles is permitted on the premises and only when
  conducted within a fully enclosed building; The site shall be improved and
  maintained per the parking lot requirements of Article 19 of this Chapter;
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or
  lapsed license for more than six months will negatively impact your
  license renewal; Display State of California dealer's license and any
  applicable permits / licenses issued by the California DMV; NO
  parking, staging, repairs or maintenance of any vehicles on any City
  streets, sidewalks or alleys; Subject to random inspections by any
  City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer (IPD or DMV
  Investigators) at anytime to ensure compliance; Ensure safe pedestrian
  and vehicular circulation on/off site; and adhere to all State, Federal and
 Permits & License Committee  February 27, 2020
Minutes  Page 4 of 6

  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00296112)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request(s):
A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE Items 8-11:

Item #8:  Elias Khoury of Shell Station. DBA Shell Station to operate a tobacco retailer
  at 804 W. Manchester. (Activity No. 00295952)

Item #9:  Elias Khoury of USA Gas Station. DBA USA Gas Station to operate a
  tobacco retailer at 4130 W Century Blvd. (Activity No. 0025948)

Item #10:  TAE EO of Will’s Liquor – Natalietws INC. DBA Will’s Liquor to operate a
  tobacco retailer at 6513 West Blvd. (Activity No. 00296080)

Item #11:  Simon Farahdel of Hillcrest Oil, Holdings, LLC. DBA Hillcrest Oil to operate
  a tobacco retailer at 501 E. Manchester Blvd. (Activity No. 00291096)

Subject to Standard Recommendations as follows: Sales of single cigarettes is strictly
prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
21 is strictly prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
have valid identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting underage
access to tobacco use, including hookah products; “NO LOITERING,” “NO
TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING” signage must be posted outside of the
business; sales of marijuana and cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics
paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack”
cocaine, methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes
used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or
display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns
is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their
designees is subject to random Permits & Licensing establishment inspections at any time
of the day or night by any Police and Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random
inspections is to enforce business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by
the City of Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or
gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music, disc jockeys
(DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required to operate within normal
business hours; adhere to state, federal and all applicable IMC rules and regulations,
including noise and signage.
